note: Reconstructed from project discussions, screenshots and user statements. Not a verified Git or deployment log. Nothing here is marked LIVE_VERIFIED.

rows.title: Research observatory / case archive
rows.origin: Internal design discussions
rows.decision_or_proposal: Maintain source-rich investigative case inventory with uncertainty and opposing evidence
rows.why: A navigable historical case library supports ongoing research
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Designed / some prototypes reported
rows.evidence_and_limits: Internal planning record; precise first implementation date unverified

rows.title: 50-state ballot map and plain-language voter information
rows.origin: Project planning; user-reported site
rows.decision_or_proposal: Make ballots accessible by state with source-linked explanations and consequences
rows.why: Visitors need a practical entry point; map turns complex elections into local questions
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: User reported built; independent live audit pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: User reported nationwide ballot map; do not claim every state content verified

rows.title: Water/deep-blue homepage visual identity
rows.origin: Homepage screenshot and review
rows.decision_or_proposal: Water-based transitions, darkening blue and spacious presentation
rows.why: Create coherent memorable identity without partisan symbolism
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design demonstrated in screenshot; deployment/version unverified
rows.evidence_and_limits: Screenshot-based report

rows.title: Nonpartisan Money Timeline and network
rows.origin: Research / website planning
rows.decision_or_proposal: Connect donors, intermediaries, institutions, payments and policies
rows.why: Follow money with typed relationships and visible uncertainty
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Prototype / implementation pending audit
rows.evidence_and_limits: Source money data not necessarily complete

rows.title: Preserve every source and historical revision
rows.origin: Project research requirements
rows.decision_or_proposal: Record originals, capture time, hashes, edit history and corrections
rows.why: Links break and websites change; preserve reproducibility
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design requirement; per-source preservation requires verification
rows.evidence_and_limits: Do not label link-only source preserved

rows.title: Pull a Thread. Find its Way.
rows.origin: Internal project design
rows.decision_or_proposal: Backward-and-forward linked investigation from controversy to origins and consequences
rows.why: Consistent research navigation across civic topics
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Accepted concept; site integration unverified
rows.evidence_and_limits: User approved methodology

rows.title: Five entrypoints: Map News Timeline Provenance Methods
rows.origin: Internal project planning
rows.decision_or_proposal: Expose five views of shared evidence database
rows.why: Different audiences need distinct starting points, not siloed datasets
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design adopted; deployment audit pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: No assumption that all five are functional

rows.title: Two-Minute Rule
rows.origin: Public Reddit discussion and project response
rows.decision_or_proposal: Visitors find a meaningful finding, see evidence and choose next connection within 120 seconds
rows.why: Avoid massive unreadable vote lists; progressive disclosure
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Accepted requirement; usability tests pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: Anonymous Reddit commenter, identity withheld

rows.title: First-paragraph hook and visual explanation
rows.origin: User editorial direction
rows.decision_or_proposal: Every article opens with substance and question; graphics explain before deep dive
rows.why: Engage quickly without sacrificing rigor
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Accepted editorial requirement; template not site-audited
rows.evidence_and_limits: Never sensationalize beyond evidence

rows.title: Expectation Gap / within-supporter context
rows.origin: Anonymous Reddit feedback
rows.decision_or_proposal: Compare official with own campaign promises, party peers and constituent priorities
rows.why: Generic party alignment reveals little; notable departures are useful
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Design exploration, not launched
rows.evidence_and_limits: Requires defensible peer and polling baselines

rows.title: Public Development Ledger
rows.origin: User approval following public criticism
rows.decision_or_proposal: Track proposal, rationale, alternatives, decision, credit, review, implementation and evidence
rows.why: Apply Institute accountability principles to its own development
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Specification accepted; publication pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: Contributor privacy and consent important

rows.title: Religion Freedom and Power timeline linked to Money Timeline
rows.origin: Project research phases 01–07
rows.decision_or_proposal: Historic beliefs/institutions/policy/finance linked through shared evidence graph
rows.why: Use one system to trace ideas and material impacts
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Research packets created; Claude integration pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: Do not conflate coincidental links with causality

rows.title: AI-use transparency brief
rows.origin: User request
rows.decision_or_proposal: Explain AI research, writing, design, extraction and review roles; human accountability
rows.why: Trust requires disclosing AI capabilities and limits
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Documented policy; public implementation pending
rows.evidence_and_limits: No claim every result was verified by a human

rows.title: State change only after verified implementation
rows.origin: User clarification
rows.decision_or_proposal: Ledger remains proposed/accepted/in-progress until Claude deploys and verification occurs; then label live
rows.why: Prevent planned concepts masquerading as shipped features
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Approved rule; ledger machinery not yet built
rows.evidence_and_limits: Live means deployed and independently smoke-tested

rows.title: What People Do section becomes an accessible accordion
rows.origin: Michi_Claude_Layout_Handoff_2026-10-25.md (approved change request)
rows.decision_or_proposal: Collapsed by default, whole title row is one button, keyboard and screen-reader support, honors reduced motion
rows.why: Keep the page short without hiding the ballot link or evidence
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Built and browser-tested in isolation; not deployed; the section itself was not found in the site copy available, so placement is unverified
rows.evidence_and_limits: Tested at 320 to 1280 px. Not yet checked on Pixel Fold or a screen reader. Not live.

rows.title: Candidate profile first-screen redesign
rows.origin: Public Reddit usability feedback (anonymous), approved 2026-10-25
rows.decision_or_proposal: Compact identity line, In their own words first, office description and background collapsed below
rows.why: The first screen should say what the person says they will do
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Built as an enhancement script; not deployed; not live
rows.evidence_and_limits: Tested on one generated page (Minnesota governor race) with 0, 2 and 4 statements. Candidate facts were not changed or verified. No Evidence Profile counts exist in the data yet.

rows.title: Retire the Michi score
rows.decision_or_proposal: Replace any composite candidate score with source-backed Evidence Profiles
rows.why: Composite scores need subjective weights and hide contested judgments
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Approved; no score was found on the site copies checked
rows.evidence_and_limits: Evidence Profile counts (votes, funding) are not built. Legal review is required before election-oriented candidate profiles.

rows.title: Four destinations, Cases renamed Civics & History
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: Header and front page offer Voter Guide, Research, Civics & History and Ballot Case Studies, plus News, Search and About. The Cases label is renamed everywhere it was a link label.
rows.why: The librarian asked for voter information to be separate from research and for clearer names.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 in Chrome on the front page, the case-studies index and the TABOR page; header text also checked on the sign-in page.
rows.evidence_and_limits: No URLs moved, so no redirects were needed. The Cases label was changed by text replacement in 56 pages; each was not opened by hand. Member-area menu label changed in code but not tested while signed in.

rows.title: Card graphics on the front page
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: Six approved illustrations (Voter Guide, Research, Ballot Case Studies, News, How government works, Civics & History) sit on six cards in the order map, ballot and research, news, civics. Art is decorative (empty alt text), WebP at 640 and 1100 pixels wide, about 30 to 140 KB each instead of 3.3 MB.
rows.why: Frank approved the artwork; the cards keep real text and links.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 in Chrome (desktop, images load under the live security policy).
rows.evidence_and_limits: Mobile crop was checked by emulating a 340 pixel card width in a desktop browser, not on a phone. The illustrations are not documents or evidence.

rows.title: Foundation and founder links hidden on the front page
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: Hidden, not deleted: the Foundation card in the Deeper waters pair, the Foundation card in the closing grid, and the footer link to the founder essay. Each carries data-hold="why-2026-10-26" and the hidden attribute. The Deeper record card and The record card stay visible.
rows.why: Frank asked for the why and philosophy cards to be hidden before the librarian email.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 in Chrome: no visible link to the foundation or founder pages on the front page.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The pages still exist at their URLs and are still reachable from the About link and the older preview home page. To restore, delete the hidden attribute and data-hold from those three links.

rows.title: TABOR ballot case study
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A draft case study with Intent, Implementation and Outcomes lanes, a text table, source links on every evidence card, a dated September 2026 forecast table, and links to Amendment 87 and Propositions NN, 136 and 137.
rows.why: The librarian-meeting to-do list asked for a TABOR case study as the first ballot case study.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 in Chrome; labeled "Initial draft, not independently reviewed".
rows.evidence_and_limits: Official 1992 and 2005 vote totals and the Article X section 20 text were read by us on Oct 26 and copies are kept privately. Final-article text of Eliason and Lutz, St. Clair and Martell and Teske is still abstract level; the 1992 and 2005 certification scans were not read because the file host blocks automated download. No reviewer has signed off.

rows.title: Site search
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A search page over 5,662 site pages with section, type, place and year filters, a plain reason for each match, and outside search links for Ballotpedia, Science.gov and CQ Researcher.
rows.why: The librarian asked for search inside Michi and help searching outside research databases.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: LIVE_VERIFIED 2026-10-26 in Chrome (header, one search with filters).
rows.evidence_and_limits: Searches titles, short descriptions, headings, places and years, not full text. Science.gov does not take a query in its link, so it gets a Copy query button. CQ Researcher needs a library login. Saving a found source to a review queue is not built.

rows.title: News ingestion, tagging and backfill
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A 50-state collector, tagging of candidates, statewide measures and 222 local measures from the guide pages on every run, a private append-only archive, two scheduled tasks on FRAK (every 2 hours, and a weekly check), and a monthly backfill walking back to Jan 1 2026 and then further.
rows.why: The public feed had gone stale after Oct 17 because the earlier process was manual.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW. Not verified complete: backfill still running, and the scheduled runs have not yet been checked over two cycles.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The public feed shows the newest 200 per state and 3,000 overall; the private archive keeps everything collected. 225 local measures have no usable ballot code and are not tagged. No article text or page copies are kept for news yet.

rows.title: Evidence vault for cited sources
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A private store of dated copies of cited sources with SHA-256, a Wayback copy where allowed, a screenshot, and text or OCR, with a provenance record per source and a "not yet verified by a person" default.
rows.why: Frank asked for proof copies of government documents, especially old scans, with more than one provenance.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW. Built and run on the sources the TABOR study cites; nothing here is public.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Respects robots.txt: the state host for the 1992 and 2005 scans disallows automated download, so those were recorded as blocked and second hosts at the University of Denver are being used. OCR is machine text, unproofed. No record has been verified by a person yet.

rows.title: How government works hub
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; librarian meeting feedback as reported by Frank
rows.decision_or_proposal: A hub page that says what it will cover, lists the planned roles as "not yet researched", and defines how connections will be labeled. No role page exists yet.
rows.why: ChatGPT and Frank want a civics explorer behind the "What people do" idea.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW as a placeholder hub only; the "What people do" accordion remains held on a local branch.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Role pages need sourced constitutional and statutory research per office. Until then no job description is published and no accordion links to it.

rows.title: Research & Press Resources card and page
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; designs by ChatGPT, treated as visual direction only
rows.decision_or_proposal: A card at the bottom of the front page and a "coming soon" page with a working link to the existing research library. Source lists, datasets, summaries and graphics are listed as upcoming, with no download buttons.
rows.why: Frank approved a dedicated card for researchers and journalists.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until the live pages are checked after deploy.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The page makes no promise of reuse rights and shows nothing that does not exist. Art is decorative.

rows.title: Illustrated section banners
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; designs by ChatGPT, treated as visual direction only
rows.decision_or_proposal: Compact illustrated banners (120 pixels tall, 84 on phones, static) on the Voter Guide, Research, Civics & History, Ballot Case Studies, News and How government works pages, cropped from the approved card art. The page title and controls stay as HTML.
rows.why: Frank liked the illustrated headers and wanted them across sections, smaller.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until the live pages are checked after deploy.
rows.evidence_and_limits: No shrinking sticky header was built: it was optional, and a static compact banner avoids covering content on phones. The page mockups were treated as visual references only; no mockup text or facts were used.

rows.title: Interactive TABOR timeline (reusable)
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; designs by ChatGPT, treated as visual direction only
rows.decision_or_proposal: A data-driven timeline component with 18 dated events, a "Stated purpose" and "What happened" view, filters, previous and next buttons with a position count, swipe on phones (horizontal gestures only, not from the screen edge) and a complete chronological list. Each event shows its source links and an evidence status.
rows.why: Frank wants every bill or ballot case study to use the same timeline.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until the live page is checked after deploy.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Events read by us: the 1992 and 2005 database pages, the official 2026 text of Article X section 20, three bill pages (SB22-233, SB23B-003, SB24-228) and the court opinion. Not yet read by us: the 1982 and 1997 to 2001 sources; the 1990 result is unverified. The mockup text for 2005 to 2010 was not used. Swipe was tested by script, not by hand on a phone.

rows.title: Voter Guide page redesign
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; layout taken from ChatGPT mockups, text only from the site
rows.decision_or_proposal: Illustrated hero over the existing title and text, a "Find your ballot" button to the map, a three-step strip, and the map beside a panel holding the existing "Registration and voting rules, state by state" list and the "How we check" note. URLs, the map links and all 51 state links are unchanged.
rows.why: Frank asked for the mockup layouts filled only with real site text.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until checked live.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Checked with headless Chrome screenshots at desktop and about 500 pixels wide (a browser cannot go narrower), not on a phone. Mockup copy such as "A more informed you" was left out because the site has no such text.

rows.title: News page restyle
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; layout taken from ChatGPT mockups, text only from the site
rows.decision_or_proposal: Illustrated hero over the existing title and explanation; the existing view tabs, search, state menu and source filters moved into one bar under the hero. The news feed, archive tab, sidebar, search and filters work as before.
rows.why: Frank asked for the mockup layout with the real news data only.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until checked live.
rows.evidence_and_limits: No mockup headlines, photos or topic filters were added: the site has no photos and no topic field. The mockup map and archive-by-month controls were not built because the page has no such feature yet. Headless screenshots only.

rows.title: Civics & History directory restyle with filters
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator; layout taken from ChatGPT mockups, text only from the site
rows.decision_or_proposal: Illustrated hero over the existing title and text; a search box and Topic and Time period menus above the existing case list. The menus are built from each case card's own label (topic and years), so every option matches real cases. A ?q= address pre-fills the search.
rows.why: Frank asked for the mockup directory layout with real content only.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until checked live.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Not built, because the site has no such content: the mockup's thematic category tiles and "Historical Investigations" text. Format filter omitted; cases have no format field. Filter tested with a ?q= address in headless Chrome (watergate gave 1 of 71).

rows.title: About goes to the Foundation page
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator
rows.decision_or_proposal: The header About link on every page now opens the Foundation page. That page carries visible links to About the founder, Methodology (the methods and ledger page) and the AI paper. The front-page foundation cards stay hidden.
rows.why: Frank asked for About to lead to the foundation, with the founder, methods and AI pages one click away.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW until checked live with curl; Frank will check it visually.
rows.evidence_and_limits: There is no separate methodology page. The Methodology link goes to the methods and ledger page, which says what was decided to build and whether it was verified. No new methodology text was written.

rows.title: Ballot Case Studies pages use the shared blue gradient
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator
rows.decision_or_proposal: The case-study stylesheet now sets the same page background as the Voter Guide page. This also applies to the Research & Press and How government works pages, which share that stylesheet.
rows.why: Frank saw that these pages lacked the blue gradation.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW; Frank will check it visually.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Compared by reading the CSS (the states page rule was copied), not by looking at the pages.

rows.title: Research page: Coming soon label and timeline links
rows.origin: Frank, Oct 26 2026, via the project coordinator
rows.decision_or_proposal: The Download the research card is marked Coming soon, says the full set of downloads is coming soon and that this will be a resource for scholars, journalists and anyone looking to go deeper into The Way. The evidence card now names the Intent vs. Outcome timeline and adds a link to the development ledger.
rows.why: Frank said the button went to one specific timeline, and that the package should say it is coming soon.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW; Frank will check it visually.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The first research package is a draft and stays listed. The button already linked to /timeline/, which is the Intent vs. Outcome timeline; it is now named that way, and the ledger link covers a timeline of the site itself.

rows.title: About navigation
rows.origin: Frank's requested About navigation
rows.decision_or_proposal: Use the Why The Way essay for About with Methodology, Why AI and Legal links while retaining its water design.
rows.why: Keep the About page distinct and align its navigation with its purpose.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Merged in PR #6; live appearance not independently verified.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Repository PR #6 merged; deployment and full signed-in behavior have not been verified.

rows.title: Shared header and floating controls
rows.origin: Frank's navigation and accessibility feedback
rows.decision_or_proposal: Center The Way, provide a mobile menu and a floating search, account and Back to Surface bar.
rows.why: Make site navigation and common controls easier to find.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Merged in PR #7; live appearance not independently verified.
rows.evidence_and_limits: Signed-out layout checked in a partial preview; signed-in display simulated, not tested with a real account.

rows.title: One national voter guide entry
rows.origin: Frank's feedback on inconsistent ballot and map links
rows.decision_or_proposal: Replace the older landing page's separate Colorado guide and district-map cards with one Voter Guide link to the national state-selection page.
rows.why: Provide a consistent entry point for the map and voter guides.
rows.status_as_of_2026_10_25: Proposed in this change; not yet merged or live.
rows.evidence_and_limits: The shared header already points to the national guide. This change addresses the two legacy landing-page cards; a complete site-wide audit remains outstanding.
